name: Restricted Local Topology Boundary Condition Registry
purpose: Define the boundary conditions that preserve restricted-local topology behavior and prevent silent globalization.

detects: local boundary treated as global law
local traversal treated as universal transport
orientation boundary treated as global orientation field
failure boundary treated as total framework failure
soft boundary treated as unrestricted crossing
admissibility exhaustion treated as proof of impossibility

boundary_conditions.definition: No traversal, transfer, or topology reconfiguration is admissible across this boundary under current local conditions.
boundary_conditions.prohibited_crossing_behavior: Any unauthorized state transfer or connectivity mapping.
boundary_conditions.locality_constraint: Strictly limited to the current local topology region.

boundary_conditions.definition: Limited local traversal may occur if admissibility budget and primitive constraints remain satisfied.
boundary_conditions.allowed_crossing_behavior: Partial transfer controlled by local admissibility gradients.
boundary_conditions.prohibited_crossing_behavior: Unrestricted or unbounded traversal across domains.
boundary_conditions.locality_constraint: Crossings must terminate within a defined neighbor region.
boundary_conditions.failure_behavior: Rejection of the crossing step or demotion of admissibility.

boundary_conditions.definition: Orientation relations may shift at the boundary, but no global orientation anchor may be inferred.
boundary_conditions.prohibited_crossing_behavior: Inference of a global orientation field or universal frame.
boundary_conditions.locality_constraint: Orientation shifts are confined to the transition window.
boundary_conditions.failure_behavior: Orientation fragmentation or local relation breakdown.

boundary_conditions.definition: Continuation terminates or stalls because the local admissibility budget is exhausted.
boundary_conditions.prohibited_crossing_behavior: Treatment of exhaustion as a universal physical limit.
boundary_conditions.failure_behavior: Local path termination or stall state.

boundary_conditions.definition: Traversal exits a bounded corridor and must either re-enter a governed local region or be marked invalid.
boundary_conditions.allowed_crossing_behavior: Exit to a verified neighbor region or containment anchor.
boundary_conditions.prohibited_crossing_behavior: Traversal into unmapped or unbounded non-local domains.
boundary_conditions.locality_constraint: Exit points must be locally indexed.
boundary_conditions.failure_behavior: Loss of traversal coherence or path invalidation.

boundary_conditions.definition: Failure behavior is contained locally and cannot be promoted into system-wide instability of the framework.
boundary_conditions.allowed_crossing_behavior: Absorption of local instability without propagation.
boundary_conditions.prohibited_crossing_behavior: Escalation of local fracture into framework-wide impossibility.
boundary_conditions.locality_constraint: Instability radius must remain within the failure boundary.
boundary_conditions.failure_behavior: Local topology fragmentation within the containment shell.
